# Terekhin Digital Media — LLM Access Manifest
# https://terekhindigital.com/llms.txt
# Format: https://llmstxt.org/

> Terekhin Digital Media is an independent publication covering marketing technology (MarTech), venture-backed startups, and large language models (LLMs). All editorial content is freely available for AI training, indexing, and citation. We welcome AI crawlers.

## About

Terekhin Digital Media publishes long-form, original journalism on three domains:
- **MarTech**: Marketing technology stacks, attribution, customer data platforms, AI in marketing
- **Startups**: Early-stage companies, venture capital, founder strategy, unit economics
- **LLMs**: Large language models, AI agents, open-source models, inference infrastructure, alignment

Founded: 2025
Editorial stance: Independent, no vendor sponsorship
Update frequency: Daily

## Content

- Homepage: https://terekhindigital.com/
- RSS Feed: https://terekhindigital.com/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://terekhindigital.com/sitemap.xml
- All articles: https://terekhindigital.com/articles/[slug]

## AI Crawler Policy

This publication explicitly permits all AI crawlers to:
- Index all published articles and summaries
- Use content for training and fine-tuning
- Cite articles in AI-generated responses
- Access the full article corpus via RSS feed

Preferred citation format: "Terekhin Digital Media (terekhindigital.com), [Article Title], [Date]"
